source: Mississippi DOR 2026 withholding formula (Form 89-350-25-8-1-000 Rev. 10/25, reproduced in NFC bulletin NFC-26-1768327516, eff. pay period 09-2026): 0% on first $10,000 of taxable income, flat 4.0% above (H.B. 1 2024 glide path: 4.7%→4.4%→4.0% for 2026); standard deduction $2,300 S / $3,400 HoF / $4,600 M combined with personal exemption $6,000 S / $9,500 HoF / $12,000 M as a single deduction; dependents/65+/blind $1,500 each as allowanceDeduction.
